scope: Encoded: ss 39A, 39B, 40A, 40B, 40C, 40D, 40E, 41, 44, 45, 46, 46A, 46B, 47A; s 35(e) through rules 2 and 3 of the rules of 5738-1977; s 47(d) through regulations 1 and 2 of the Regulations of 5740-1980; the Retirement Age Law ss 3 and 6 and the Schedule's Parts A and B. Inert: ss 40F, 41A, 42, 43, 45(b), 46(a1), (a2), (b), (d), 46C, rules 4 and 5, regulation 3. Out of scope with reasons: the Retirement Age Law's compulsory and early retirement ages; the Laws whose definitions the caller states as facts. Needs a source (refused by name): the commencement of s 39B; ss 40C and 40D for studies that ended before 2014 and 2018; the regulations of 5756-1996 (ss 44, 45) and of 5751-1991 (s 47A(c)); Part B for a woman born before May 1947.
tax_years_answered: from 2024 (s 39B from 2026); a year after 2026 on the text at retrieval (a projection)

not_reviewed.note: No domain expert has read this encoding against the source. No independent test pass has been run yet (one session, without sub-agents, as briefed). Every expected value in the tests was worked by hand from the text by the same session that wrote the rules.
